body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Reduce the next incoming Damage you take by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: You also resist the next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
Extend the protection to one adjacent willing ally.

rider.title: Combo - Guard
rider.html: You may enter Reed Stance: while you have not moved since your last turn began, the first forced movement against you each round is reduced by 1 unit.
